name: LearnPulse
shortDescription: Privacy-conscious learning analytics with transparent, evidence-backed support flags.
features: Idempotent CSV event import with row-level rejection reasons
Computed dashboards with date filters and metric definitions
Transparent support flags with exact rules and event evidence
Teacher annotations and supportive follow-up actions
Exports with data sources, definitions and quality notes
knownLimitations: CSV/API ingestion only (no live LMS connector in this MVP)
Retention jobs are deployment-configured, not automated here
